items.summary: Mortgages in Israel and abroad, early-stage startup.
highlights: Led product development prior to launch, including roadmap updates and task prioritization based on strategic changes.
Developed go-to-market strategy for competitive markets, integrating unique tech solutions with rapid market adaptations.
Managed strategic vendors (core systems and digital) ensuring technical quality and on-time delivery.
Directed blitzscaling efforts to penetrate multiple niches simultaneously.
Met aggressive targets within short timeframes, operated effectively under uncertainty, and optimized resource allocation.

items.summary: Software development company in the Fintech sector.
highlights: Managed end-to-end delivery of Web and Fintech mobile applications, as well as B2C event, dating apps, and a smart AI search platform.
Designed and planned complex API integrations with ERP systems, governmental bodies, and external APIs.
Led a team of 10 (frontend, backend, QA, design, Scrum master, CTO) under Scrum of Scrums methodology.
Key clients: Menora Mivtachim, ERN, Bar-Ilan University, and LoanWise.

items.summary: Managed 90 staff members and an 800,000 NIS budget, and specified and implemented a management information system.
highlights: Managed 90 staff members across the learning center environment.
Owned an 800,000 NIS budget.
Specified and implemented a management information system.
Managed an Agile/Kanban team of 6 (dev, design, QA).
Took the product from concept to MVP launch in 6 months.
Delivered full technical specifications (DB, ERD, UX), selected technologies, and designed system architecture.

items.summary: Led a team of 4 to build a long-term rental management system from scratch, designing a large and complex database.
highlights: Led a team of 4 through the system build.
Built the product from scratch.
Designed a large and complex database.

items.summary: EdTech ERP and SaaS solutions for education organizations.
highlights: Produced technical specs for ERP modules.

Integrated hardware and software via secure communication protocols.
